mainEntity.name: What is the contract buyout program?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's a program that helps you move to Prompt even when you're locked into a long-term agreement with your current EMR.

mainEntity.name: Does Prompt pay off my old contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. That's the core of the program. When you switch, Prompt will cover your existing contract and handle the work of getting you out of it. The exact amount depends on your situation, so book a demo and the team will walk through the details.
